title: What should AAA game devs do
excerpt: tldr: go broad not tall, and try everything the honest truth is that the leaders of AAA game developer don't know what is gonna come next, AND that is ok....
content_html:
22 Nov, 2026

tldr: go broad not tall, and try everything

the honest truth is that the leaders of AAA game developer don't know what is gonna come next, AND that is ok.

AAA have never been forward thinking really, their job has always been to take more niche ideas, broaden their appeal, polish them to a mirror shine and then launch them at scale.

The problem they find themselves in this moment is that no one really knows what the next big thing is. It was supposed to be some combination of games as a service and maybe extraction shooters?

The problem is that that was what everyone did, so many well enough Game as a Service games exists, too many for me to every play, so only a very small few are gonna last, as the entire point go those games is to capture your entire gaming life.

So what should you do?

Try everything, and all things.

Cap team size at four, Design, Artist, Programmer, and Producer.

Then try thirty ideas, try from people you don't trust, try from people who give you the oddest ideas.

Because that is the only way you find the next big thing before someone else does, a random walk in all directions.

Some AAA game developers will be fine, those that have income streams that should be able to sustain them for the next few years to keep them afloat until some new game idea comes out of the III game space and they are able to fast follow it into large enough unfulfilled market.

So again, leaders of AAA game studios, TRY EVERYTHING.
